1074-1719-4613.easyPrerequisites:
King Macar doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1074-1719-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1074-1719-4613.description:
Activate King Macar using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping King Macar
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do.
Repeat.

1168-1479-2841-3897.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1168-1479-2841-3897.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2150-2281-6495.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2150-2281-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

620-2034-2111.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

6657-7954-7955.easyPrerequisites: You have not changed the value of X this turn using Glava's ability.
6657-7954-7955.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Bahamut triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, targeting Summon: Bahamut's trigger.
Glava triggers, causing the value of X used for Gogo's ability to become 5 instead.
Resolve Gogo's ability, copying Summon: Bahamut's trigger five times.
Resolve all Summon: Bahamut triggers, dealing damage to each opponent equal to six times the total mana value of permanents you control other than Summon: Bahamut.
6657-7954-7955.notes: If you control no other permanents with mana values above 0, you'll deal 60 damage to each opponent.

1409-3099-3499-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1879-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-1879-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4809-5660-6872.description:
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Shifting Wall from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1475-2511-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-2511-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

851-2762-4659.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

57-1251-3094-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1251-3094-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with eight or more +1/+1 counters on it
attached to any creature you control except Sekki

1475-1724-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sekki
When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5078-6709-6918.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
5078-6709-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

803-3951-5703-6798.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
803-3951-5703-6798.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5485-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5485-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

81-2060-2092-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
81-2060-2092-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

3542-5140-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
3542-5140-5147.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Palinchron, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1339-1926-2899.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Insect" chosen with Species Specialist.
1339-1926-2899.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Species Specialist triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2788-3634-4568-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
2788-3634-4568-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

236-539-5175.notablePrerequisites:
"Green" chosen with Caged Sun.
Caged Sun does not have summoning sickness.
236-539-5175.description:
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, causing Caged Sun to become an artifact creature until end of turn and exiling Bring to Life.
Activate Caged Sun by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat step 3.
As Caged Sun's triggered ability is a mana ability, this combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that cannot be interacted with, thus ending the game in a draw.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-2452-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a Zombie card in hand or in your graveyard.
598-2452-5256.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast a Zombie from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat from step 2.

570-618-3750.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-618-3750.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Activate all Faeburrow Elders you control to add at least {R}{R}{G}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Aggravated Assualt, untapping all creatures you control and gaining an addition combat step and post combat mainphase.
Repeat.

2556-3617-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Mnemonic Wall.
2556-3617-4305.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
